# OS-QANET D1: File, NEW, then Sample load on a card with content, the listing asserted (OS-BUG-NEWLIST: on the unit, Sample load showed an empty card after File NEW until the card was taken out and put back;
# it did not reproduce on a host folder, a scripted File, NEW, Sample load listed correctly). The card is the large card of the random user (qanet_card: about 2000 files in 50 folders, long names with spaces and
# non-ASCII letters, generated by tools/qanet_card.py). The same lines run on the folder (scenario_e2e_newlist) and on a FAT32 image of it, through the unit's FatFs (scenario_fatfs_e2e_newlist, sim/CMakeLists.txt):
# the point of the image run is FatFs's long names and directory order, its handles and its listing of a folder of 600 entries. `sel` is the name of the entry under the cursor of the listing: `-` is an empty listing.
document
wait 20
card qanet_card
wait 20
tap file
wait 800
assert state screen=FILE sel=~^[^-]
tap f3
wait 20
tap f3
wait 500
assert state screen=PATTERN msg=NEW_PROJECT
tap sampleload
wait 1500
assert state screen=SAMPLE_LOAD sel=~^[^-]
# and back: File lists again, and so does Sample load a second time
tap file
wait 800
assert state screen=FILE sel=~^[^-]
tap sampleload
wait 800
assert state screen=SAMPLE_LOAD sel=~^[^-]
